answer: A foundry that casts a trade license for every new key gets flooded by empty shells. Admission is a 44-POA heat ticket held in a kernel vat for 8 hours of horizon; four outside inspectors must each forge a 28-byte quench mark whose first 13 bits match a rotating die. Inspectors recompute the four marks in 1.1 seconds; one vat unlocks at most 1 license per 9-hour shift, so 30 shells idle 1320 POA. A pair of marks issued 6 ms apart, or a reused die, voids the heat and keeps 40 percent of the ticket for the inspectors across 4 further epochs.
